title: Where the Time Goes
lot_rule: a lot whose clip includes a lithography step, a metrology step, an etch step and a wait of over 60 minutes

shots.name: Establishing
captions: A wafer fab campus of our own design, run from the SMT2020 testbed.

shots.name: Round the campus
captions: 1,043 tools in two buildings, joined by an overhead hoist.

shots.name: The cut
captions: Air space: fans push filtered air down.

shots.name: Through the cut
captions: Each lot is one carrier of wafers.

shots.name: The ride
captions: Across the bridge to Phase 1 for coat and develop. 4 minutes on the hoist.

shots.name: Yellow light
captions: It waits 15 minutes, then spends 51 on the track.

shots.name: Exposure
captions: Back to Phase 2 for exposure: 14 minutes waiting, 71 on the scanner.

shots.name: Three beats
captions: Measured, checked, etched: 2 hours 17 minutes on three tools.

shots.name: The queue
captions: Then it waits. Two hours in the queue for wet etch.

shots.name: Up through the ceiling
captions: Moving: 26 minutes. Waiting: almost three hours.

shots.name: All lots
captions: Across the fab, half of lot time was spent waiting for a tool and 3% moving.
Our layout cut hoist travel by 30%. Cycle time did not clearly change.

shots.name: Back out
captions: Which lot should go next? In Fab Gym, an agent proposes, the simulator scores, a person signs.

shots.name: End card
captions: Fab Gym. A gigafab-style layout of our own design on the SMT2020 testbed. Not a real fab.

note: Numbers in captions are today's run; after the re-pack the film build fills them from the re-packed run and the lot re-chosen by lot_rule. Shot 6 follows the lot's real ride, in whichever building it is.
